variety_description: High yielding, medium maturity, short stature, long slender variety suitable for cultivation under irrigated lowland conditions. It was released in 2014 by BRRI for planting all over Bangladesh in Boro season. Tolerant to lodging and shattering. High elongation ability of cooked grain. Premium quality rice for export. Susceptible to leaf blast and leaf blight.
